output: html_document

```{r}
teiXpath <- list(
  title = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/titleStmt/title",
  legislativePeriod = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/titleStmt/legislativePeriod",
  sessionNo = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/titleStmt/sessionNo",
  date = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/publicationStmt/date",
  publisher = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/publicationStmt/publisher",
  url = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/sourceDesc/url",
  filetype = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/sourceDesc/filetype",
  retrievalDate = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/sourceDesc/date",
  package = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/editionStmt/edition/package",
  version = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/editionStmt/edition/version",
  birthday = "//TEI/teiHeader/fileDesc/editionStmt/edition/birthday"
)
```


```{r}
save(
  teiXpath,
  file = "~/Lab/gitlab/frappp/data/PlPr.RData"
  )
```
